author_doubts_decisions: 1. meerijden criterion 2 residue: no content change. The miss is a judge-side edge case (address in a separate sentence, 1 of 36 runs). The starter 'Je kunt mij ophalen bij … om …' already steers learners towards an explicit pick-up sentence.

2. Petrol money as 'bedankje': keep. It is the usual way to repay a lift and fits the English criterion and the starter 'Als dank wil ik graag …'. It met the criterion in 18/18 runs, while 'Dank je wel!' failed 3/3.
3. kast 'Kan het zaterdag om tien uur?': keep. It follows 'Kun je mij helpen met dragen?', names a day and a time, and matches the starter.

4. bezorging 'om 10 uur' beside 'de hele dag thuis': keep (plausible learner text). The starter 'Kunt u de wasmachine bezorgen op …?' also stays, because natural completions ('op donderdag om tien uur') do not need 'volgende week'.
5. lantaarnpaal 'sinds vorige week maandag': keep. It is idiomatic and consistent with 'al een week'.
6. supermarkt at 40 words with 'bij de ingang': keep. It is within the limit, and the place does not contradict picture 3.
7. Wijkkrant trims: all three accepted. The repeated 'meestal' in boodschappen mirrors two guiding questions.
8. sportclub starter 'Hij heeft deze sport … gedaan.': accepted. Completions for both yes and no are grammatical.
9. Left unchanged: huur '1 december' has no year and stays in the future; the sportclub sample may answer a field in two sentences.
diversity: The replacement keeps all eleven IDs, topics and set memberships (a2-writing-04 to a2-writing-07). The two picture notes share their frame, as the task type requires, and both sit in a2-writing-07. That membership predates this batch. A mock form should hold only one of them.
